original_record.question: A game marker in the shape of a regular tetrahedron has one marked area. That side is placed on the triangle marked START. The marker is then moved within the diagram always to the next adjacent triangle by rolling it around an edge. On which triangle is the marker when it is on the marked side again for the first time? <image1>
